demo_identity.purpose: Bind one passive evidence-collection session to the REST room lifecycle contract.

evidence_scope.scope_rule: Capture only this single HOME-to-REST-to-HOME episode; do not infer what led to the choice of REST or what should happen next.

items: detected REST entry evidence when available

intermediate_state_categories.rule: Record observed categories and screenshots; do not require or invent a complete state list.

shared_handlers.rule: Record a handler only when its human interaction and before/after evidence are present; choices remain protected evidence.

items: human annotation if result meaning is unclear
fresh HOME observation after REST interaction

unknown_linkage.impact: Intermediate REST progress or result cannot be assumed from a HOME return alone.
A complete REST HOME-to-HOME lifecycle has not yet been established by this manifest.
This manifest must not define whether REST completed successfully or which effect proves completion.

FACT.meaning: Directly captured event or observation with an explicit evidence reference.

INFERENCE.meaning: Offline relationship derived from linked evidence, such as a unique configured action match.
INFERENCE.promotion: Requires review before any operational use.

PROVISIONAL.meaning: Human or compiler hypothesis awaiting validation.
PROVISIONAL.promotion: Cannot be treated as runtime fact.

UNKNOWN.meaning: Missing, ambiguous, conflicting, or unstable evidence.
UNKNOWN.promotion: Blocks deterministic promotion until explicitly resolved.

forbidden_content: automatic production action or configuration promotion

terminal_states.meaning: Describe recording-package completeness only; terminal capture status is not a gameplay success verdict.
